sql: SELECT "Claim_Headers"."Claim_Header_ID" AS k, (CAST("Claim_Headers"."Amount_Piad" AS REAL) / "Claim_Headers"."Amount_Claimed") AS m1 FROM "Claim_Headers" WHERE (CAST("Claim_Headers"."Amount_Piad" AS REAL) / "Claim_Headers"."Amount_Claimed") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: Claim_Headers.amount paid on claim relative to amount claimed
why: amount paid on claim / amount claimed: a ratio of two quantities in USD
rank Claim_Headers rows by amount paid on claim relative to amount claimed

sql: SELECT "Claim_Headers"."Claim_Header_ID" AS k, ("Claim_Headers"."Amount_Claimed" - "Claim_Headers"."Amount_Piad") AS m1 FROM "Claim_Headers" WHERE ("Claim_Headers"."Amount_Claimed" - "Claim_Headers"."Amount_Piad") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: Claim_Headers.amount claimed minus amount paid on claim
why: amount claimed - amount paid on claim: both in USD and of the same kind (flows) on the same one insurance claim
rank Claim_Headers rows by amount claimed minus amount paid on claim
